# routeros_tool_traffic_generator (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `latency_distribution_max` (String) Upper bound of the latency distribution histogram, for example `100us`. Latency values above this bound are counted in the last bucket.
> The value is a RouterOS time interval and may use the `us`, `ms`, `s` postfixes. It is compared as an opaque string, so use the same notation that the router reports back.
- `measure_out_of_order` (Boolean) Whether out of order packets are detected and counted during a test.
- `stats_samples_to_keep` (Number) How many statistics samples are kept in memory (0..4294967295).
- `test_id` (Number) Identifier that is embedded into the generated packets so that the receiving side can tell several parallel tests apart.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
